info.title: Amrutam Telemedicine API
info.description: Submission implementation. Clinical doctor/admin operations require MFA. Payment provider integration is not configured; no payment mutation API is exposed.

post.description: Passwords are also limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Registration does not issue a token.

post.summary: Login with password and enrolled MFA
post.description: Enrolled users must supply one unused TOTP or recoveryCode. Access-token expiry defaults to 900 seconds. Passwords are limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes.
Returns secret and otpauthUri once for setup. Enrollment expires in 10 minutes. Requires current password. MFA encryption key must be configured.
Returns eight single-use recovery codes. Invalidates existing tokens. Log in again with a new TOTP or recovery code.

patch.summary: Create or update own doctor profile
patch.description: Doctor only. At least one field required; initial creation needs fullName and specialty/specialization. Approval fields cannot be self-edited.

post.description: Doctor only. End must follow start; doctor lock serializes overlap checks.

patch.description: At least one field. Booked slots cannot change; consultation-referenced times are immutable.

post.description: Patient only. Keys are scoped to patient and retained with the consultation; identical retries replay original creation response even after cancellation. Without a key, duplicates return a slot conflict.
Owner patient, assigned doctor, or admin. Optional body. Repeated cancellation returns 409. Future slots are released; elapsed slots become unavailable.

get.summary: List own patient or doctor consultations
get.description: Doctors require MFA. Admins use analytics or authorized detail endpoints.
Owning patient, assigned doctor or admin. Doctor/admin must be MFA authenticated. Reads are audited.

patch.description: Assigned approved doctor with MFA. scheduled → in_progress → completed. Repeating current state is idempotent. Cancellation uses booking endpoint.

post.description: Assigned approved doctor with MFA. Consultation must be in_progress or completed. Idempotency-Key is required and scoped to doctor; changed payload returns 409.

get.description: Owner patient, assigned doctor or admin; doctor/admin require MFA. Reads are audited.
Admin plus MFA. Default last 30 days, maximum 366-day range. No identifiable patient details.

patch.description: Admin plus MFA. Audited; repeated status assignment has same resource outcome.

get.description: Admin plus MFA. Descending ID cursor is returned as nextCursor; pass it as before.
Admin plus MFA; configure an authenticated scraper and refresh access tokens.
